title: Cherrypicking with multi-channel pipette substituting for a single channel pipette
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Upload a CSV file formatted as described (including headers), set the source plate type, destination plate type, and reservoir type (or None if no reservoir in slot 9), select the pipette model and its mount (left or right), choose tip type (filter or regular), decide tip usage strategy (new tip each transfer or reuse), and set the starting tiprack slot (default slot 4, tipracks ordered from slot 4 onward).

substeps.instruction: Input .csv file: upload a correctly formatted CSV with headers.
Source Plate Type: specify the plate to cherrypick from.
Destination Plate Type: specify the plate to dispense into.
Reservoir Type: same as part 1 or set to None if absent.
Pipette Model: select the multi‑channel pipette to use.
Pipette Mount: specify left or right mount.
Tip Type: choose filter‑tips or regular tips.
Tip Usage Strategy: choose new tip per transfer or reuse same tip.
Starting Tiprack Slot: default slot 4; tipracks ordered from slot 4 onward.

steps.title: Aspirate volume from source well
steps.instruction: The pipette aspirates the user‑specified volume from the source well at the aspiration height (from the bottom) defined for that well in the CSV file.

steps.title: Dispense volume into target well
steps.instruction: The pipette dispenses the aspirated volume into the target well specified in the CSV file.

steps.title: Repeat for each CSV line
steps.instruction: Repeat the aspiration and dispense steps for every line in the CSV file.
